text: Because the buttermilk is already sour, hazo is a second, spiced fermentation of the leftover.

steps.note: The sour, fat-free buttermilk is fermented again with flour of a pulse (a dried bean or pea) or of a cereal, pepper and garlic.

processing.text: A second, spiced fermentation of arrera, the already sour defatted buttermilk of ergo, with pulse or cereal flour, pepper and garlic. The cultures are not specified; adding a little new hazo weekly keeps it up to about a month.
